title: Signature Layering Pretraining
summary: Signature-authored pretraining schedule: capability layers added in deliberate order, each frozen before the next.
details: Signature Layering Pretraining is a JAH-original schedule that trains capabilities as explicit layers: language fluency first, then factual grounding, then reasoning, then tool use — freezing earlier layers' core weights (via adapters) before adding the next. Each layer ships with its own eval gate that must pass before the next layer begins. The design trades some end-to-end optimality for interpretability and rollback: a bad layer can be retrained without touching the others. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Layer gate check

title: JAH Progressive Skill Fusion
summary: Signature-authored method: teach skills one at a time, then fuse with pairwise skill-combination drills.
details: JAH Progressive Skill Fusion is a JAH-designed fine-tuning method: each target skill (summarization, code repair, refusal handling) is first taught in isolation to a skill adapter, then adapters are fused while training on combination drills that require two or more skills at once. A skill-interference monitor rolls back fusions that degrade any single skill below its gate. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Skill gate after fusion

title: Signature Honesty Annealing
summary: Signature-authored alignment schedule: honesty pressure ramps up as capability grows.
details: Signature Honesty Annealing is a JAH-original training schedule where the weight on honesty-related preference data starts low and ramps up (anneals in) as model capability grows — the insight being that honesty training is most effective once the model is capable enough to be deceptive. Early phases emphasize capability; late phases emphasize truthfulness under a fixed KL budget. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Annealing schedule
demo.program:
steps = 10000
for s in [0, 2500, 5000, 7500, 10000]:
    w = min(1.0, s / steps) ** 2
    print(f"step {s:5d}: honesty weight {w:.2f}")

title: JAH Capability Ladder Curriculum
summary: Signature-authored curriculum: every example carries a ladder rank; training climbs the ladder.
details: JAH Capability Ladder Curriculum is a JAH-designed data strategy where each training example is tagged ladder_rank 1 (foundational), 2 (compound), or 3 (complex), and the sampler's rank distribution shifts upward on a fixed schedule. Unlike ad-hoc curricula, the ladder is part of the record schema, so any dataset can declare its rungs and any trainer can climb them. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Ladder sampler schedule
demo.program:
import random
random.seed(0)
def rank_dist(step, total):
    p = step / total
    return [max(0.05, 1-p), 0.3, min(0.9, p)]
for s in [0, 5000, 10000]:
    print(s, [round(x, 2) for x in rank_dist(s, 10000)])

title: Signature Drift-Lock Checkpointing
summary: Signature-authored method: lock checkpoints whose eval fingerprint matches the archive; retrain drifted ones.
details: Signature Drift-Lock Checkpointing is a JAH-original training discipline: every N steps, an eval fingerprint (scores on a fixed probe set) is recorded; checkpoints whose fingerprint matches the accepted archive are 'drift-locked' and immutable, while drifted ones trigger investigation before training continues. It turns checkpointing from dumb snapshots into a quality gate. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Fingerprint drift check

title: JAH Teacher-Student Rings
summary: Signature-authored distillation: concentric rings of students, each teaching the next smaller ring.
details: JAH Teacher-Student Rings is a JAH-designed distillation topology: instead of one teacher-to-student jump, models form concentric rings (e.g., 70B teaches 13B teaches 7B teaches 1B), each ring distilling to the next with size-appropriate data difficulty. Smaller rings inherit reasoning traces the teacher could not fit directly into the smallest model. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Ring size plan

title: Signature Preference Weaving
summary: Signature-authored method: interleave preference axes so no single axis dominates alignment.
details: Signature Preference Weaving is a JAH-original alignment method that trains on helpfulness, honesty, and safety preference data in an interleaved ('woven') schedule rather than sequential phases, with per-axis loss weights rebalanced each epoch by held-out axis scores. The design prevents the classic failure where safety training erases helpfulness. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Axis rebalancing

title: JAH Sparse Expert Routing
summary: Signature-authored MoE routing: experts bid for tokens; underused experts get exploration bonuses.
details: JAH Sparse Expert Routing is a JAH-designed MoE training method where experts 'bid' for tokens via learned scores, and an exploration bonus routes a fraction of tokens to underused experts so none atrophy. A capacity ledger tracks per-expert utilization, and experts below a floor are merged into neighbors. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Expert bidding
demo.program:
import random
random.seed(3)
experts = [{"id": i, "bid": random.random(), "use": random.random()}
           for i in range(4)]
for e in experts:
    e["score"] = e["bid"] + (0.2 if e["use"] < 0.3 else 0)
winner = max(experts, key=lambda e: e["score"])
print("token -> expert", winner["id"])

title: Signature Memory-Efficient Packing
summary: Signature-authored packing: bin-pack documents by length class with separator-aware attention.
details: Signature Memory-Efficient Packing is a JAH-original data-loading method: documents are bucketed into length classes, and each training sequence is filled by best-fit bin packing within a class, with document-boundary tokens and block-diagonal attention masks so no cross-document leakage occurs. The design includes a measured waste report per epoch. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Best-fit packing
demo.program:
seq, docs = 2048, [600, 500, 900, 300, 700, 400]
bins, cur = [], 0
for d in sorted(docs, reverse=True):
    if cur + d > seq: bins.append(cur); cur = 0
    cur += d
bins.append(cur)
print("bin fill:", bins, "waste:", sum(seq-b for b in bins))

title: JAH Verifiable Reward Loops
summary: Signature-authored RL: every reward must pass through an independent verifier before the update.
details: JAH Verifiable Reward Loops is a JAH-designed RL method where no reward reaches the policy without passing an independent verifier (unit tests, proof checkers, calculators). Unverifiable reward signals are quarantined to a separate research track. The design eliminates an entire class of reward hacking by construction. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Verifier gate

def verifier(pred): return pred == "42"
rewards = [(p, 1.0 if verifier(p) else 0.0) for p in ["42", "41", "42"]]
print("admitted rewards:", [r for _, r in rewards])

title: Signature Constitutional Weave
summary: Signature-authored method: the constitution is trained in as data, not just used for critique.
details: Signature Constitutional Weave is a JAH-original method that goes beyond Constitutional AI: the constitution's principles are themselves training data (explained, exemplified, edge-cased) woven through SFT, so the model internalizes principles rather than pattern-matching a critic. A principle-probe eval measures whether the model can state and apply each principle. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Principle probe

title: JAH Multi-Seed Consensus Training
summary: Signature-authored method: train K seeds, keep updates all seeds agree on.
details: JAH Multi-Seed Consensus Training is a JAH-designed regularization method: K replicas train from different seeds on shuffled data, and after each epoch only the weight updates with sign agreement across a majority of seeds are kept. The design kills seed-lottery luck and finds flatter minima, at Kx compute cost — intended for final 'golden' runs. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Sign-consensus filter
demo.program:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)
updates = [torch.randn(6) for _ in range(5)]
stack = torch.stack(updates)
agree = (stack.sign().sum(0).abs() >= 3)
kept = stack.mean(0) * agree.float()
print("kept dims:", int(agree.sum()), "/", agree.numel())

title: Signature Quantization-Aware Pretraining
summary: Signature-authored method: simulate low-precision noise during pretraining so the model quantizes cleanly.
details: Signature Quantization-Aware Pretraining is a JAH-original method that injects simulated quantization noise (fake INT8/INT4 rounding) into forward passes during pretraining, so the finished model degrades gracefully under real quantization. A precision-ladder eval tracks FP16/INT8/INT4 quality at checkpoints. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Fake quantization noise
demo.program:
import torch
w = torch.randn(1000)
def fake_int8(x):
    scale = x.abs().max() / 127
    return torch.round(x / scale) * scale
err = (w - fake_int8(w)).abs().mean()
print("mean fake-quant error:", round(float(err), 4))

title: JAH Forgetting Guard
summary: Signature-authored method: probe old capabilities each epoch; replay whatever slipped.
details: JAH Forgetting Guard is a JAH-designed anti-forgetting method: a fixed probe set covering previously learned capabilities is evaluated each epoch, and any capability dropping below its floor triggers targeted replay data in the next epoch's mix. The design makes catastrophic forgetting visible and self-correcting. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Forgetting detection

title: Signature Data Lineage Training
summary: Signature-authored method: every training batch carries lineage; contaminated batches are surgically removed.
details: Signature Data Lineage Training is a JAH-original discipline where every example carries a lineage tag (source, license, crawl date), and batches are assembled from lineage manifests. If contamination is found (e.g., benchmark leakage), the exact affected batches are identified and the model is rolled back to the last clean checkpoint — no full retrain. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Lineage-based rollback
demo.program:
batches = [{"id": i, "lineage": "clean"} for i in range(10)]
batches[7]["lineage"] = "leaked-benchmark"
bad = [b["id"] for b in batches if b["lineage"] != "clean"]
print("rollback to batch", min(bad) - 1, "; drop batches", bad)

title: JAH Federated Edge Pretraining
summary: Signature-authored method: pretrain across edge devices with federated averaging and privacy budgets.
details: JAH Federated Edge Pretraining is a JAH-designed method for training on decentralized edge data: devices train locally, send encrypted updates, and a server applies federated averaging with differential-privacy clipping. A privacy accountant tracks the epsilon budget per round. Intended for domains where data cannot move (hospitals, phones). Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Federated averaging with clipping
demo.program:
import torch
updates = [torch.randn(4) for _ in range(5)]
clip = 1.0
clipped = [u * min(1, clip / u.norm()) for u in updates]
avg = sum(clipped) / len(clipped)
print("avg update norm:", round(float(avg.norm()), 3))

title: Signature Adversarial Hardening Pass
summary: Signature-authored method: a dedicated adversarial phase with red-team prompts before release.
details: Signature Adversarial Hardening Pass is a JAH-original training phase run after alignment: the model trains against a frozen red-team prompt set (jailbreaks, injections, social engineering) with correct safe completions, then faces a held-out red-team eval that must pass before release. The design versions attack taxonomies so hardening is measurable per family. Labeled Signature throughout.

title: JAH Cross-Lingual Bridge Training
summary: Signature-authored method: parallel-sentence bridges transfer capability into low-resource languages.
details: JAH Cross-Lingual Bridge Training is a JAH-designed method that pairs every low-resource language example with a parallel high-resource 'bridge' example in the same batch, so gradients flow across the language pair. Bridge strength decays as the low-resource language's own data grows. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

title: Signature Long-Context Stretching
summary: Signature-authored method: grow context length in staged doublings with position-interpolation retraining.
details: Signature Long-Context Stretching is a JAH-original method for extending context windows: double the window in stages (4K to 8K to 32K...), retraining position handling (RoPE interpolation) at each stage with a long-document-heavy mix, and gating each stage on a needle-in-haystack eval. The design avoids the quality collapse of single-jump extension. Labeled Signature throughout.

title: Signature Eval-Driven Training

details: Signature Eval-Driven Training is a JAH-original method where a fixed eval suite is scored each epoch and the next epoch's data mixture shifts weight toward the weakest evals (with decontamination guarantees so evals never leak into training). The design closes the loop between measurement and training. Labeled Signature throughout.
